title: 第686章 大败亏输第685章 复仇之矛
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
第686章大败亏输
“我滴天！”
萨克多震惊无比，双丹修士他倒是听说过，但是六丹修士他根本连听都没有听过。
这是要逆天了啊！
这要是传出去能够把人活活吓死。
难怪此人实力如此恐怖，这到底是什么人？
而且他看得出来，这些金丹代表着所有属性，特别是那枚雷属性和冰属性的金丹给他带来很大的压力。
就在萨克多的血影化身愣神的功夫，陈长生的那几枚金丹忽然猛的一个旋转，斗转星移之间，萨克多的血影化身就被六大金丹围困在其中。
那枚冰属性金丹里面释放出来极寒之力一下就被血影化身冰封住，然后雷属性金丹释放出来雷霆闪电劈了下来。
“啊！”顿时那几道血影化身就发出惨叫，被劈的外焦里嫩。
就在这时，一个混沌丹炉出现猛的把这几道血影化身给吸了进去，随即开始了炼化。
陈长生的丹田和别人的丹田不一样，居然还可以有自主反击的能力，不但有六枚金丹，而且还有一尊混沌丹炉。
本来，萨克多的血影化身要是进入到一般的金丹期丹田内会造成巨大的破坏，甚至直接抹杀都有可能。
但是没想到遇到陈长生这个怪胎。
在惨叫声中，萨克多的血影化身很快被混沌丹炉给炼化了，化作一道道血气被陈长生的身体给吸收了。
让他的肉身增长了不少，原本陈长生的肉身是15000头虎之力，现在直接增加了1000，变成了16000头虎之力。
这些血影化身是萨克多的精血凝聚成的，现在却成了滋补陈长生的肉身补品。
“可恶！”此刻在长生殿中被镇压的萨克多本尊察觉到这种情况不由脸色铁青，没想到自己的九滴精血所化的化身就这样被灭了。
“此人还真是恐怖！”萨克多心中升起深深的无力感。
此刻，在外面，勾魂使者被杀，萨克多被擒拿，勾魂使者手下逃遁，顿时引起了轩然大波。

“哼，你们的首领萨克多已经成为了阶下之囚，你们还要负隅顽抗吗？”
陈长生腾出手来，手拿巨斧，冷冷看着萨克多手下的那些高手，一字一顿的道。
“哼，退什么退，我们身后是百万士兵，退无可退，和他拼了！”一名大汉冷哼一声，这名大汉是副统帅铁木汗，他眼神坚定，“就算是战死，也不能够退缩！”
“对！和他拼了！”
“拼了！实在不行我们就自爆金丹和此人同归于尽！”
火罗国的这些人倒是很有血性，一副拼命的架势，说完那铁木汗和其余几人互相对视一眼同时朝陈长生打出法宝。
“不知死活！”
陈长生说完身体一晃消失不见，就出现在铁木汗的头顶上空，手中巨斧狠狠朝其脑袋劈了下来。
铁木汗面色大变，连忙举刀抵挡，哪里是陈长生的对手，他顿时连人带刀被劈成两半，两半尸体掉落下来，肠子流了一地。
仅仅是一招，就被陈长生给劈死了，这铁木汗实力在八千多头虎之力，和陈长生一比差距实在是太大了，根本连一招都接不下来。
第686章大败亏输
content_en:
Chapter 686: Big Defeat
"My God!"
Sacko was extremely shocked. He had heard of the Double Pill Monk, but he had never even heard of the Six Pill Monk.
This is going against the grain!
If this was spread, it would scare people to death.
No wonder this person's strength is so terrifying. Who is this person?
And he could see that these golden elixirs represented all attributes, especially the thunder-attribute and ice-attribute golden elixirs, which put a lot of pressure on him.
Just when Sakduo's blood shadow transformed into a daze, Chen Changsheng's few golden elixirs suddenly rotated fiercely. In a blink of an eye, Sakduo's blood shadow incarnation was surrounded by six golden elixirs.
The ice-attribute golden elixir released the extremely cold power and was immediately frozen by the blood shadow. Then the thunder-attribute golden elixir released thunder and lightning and struck down.
"Ah!" Immediately, the blood shadow incarnations screamed, and they were burnt on the outside and tender on the inside.
At this moment, a Chaos Alchemy Furnace appeared and sucked in the blood shadow incarnations, and then started refining them.
Chen Changsheng's dantian was different from other people's dantian. He actually had the ability to fight back independently. Not only did he have six golden elixirs, but he also had a chaos elixir furnace.
Originally, if Sakdo's blood shadow incarnation entered the dantian of an ordinary golden elixir stage, it would cause huge damage, and it might even be directly obliterated.
But I didn't expect to meet this weirdo Chen Changsheng.
Amid the screams, Sakdo's blood shadow incarnation was quickly refined by the Chaos Alchemy Furnace, and turned into streaks of blood that were absorbed by Chen Changsheng's body.
His physical body has grown a lot. Originally, Chen Changsheng's physical body had the power of 15,000 tigers, but now it has directly increased by 1,000, becoming 16,000 tigers.
These blood shadow incarnations were condensed from Sakduo's essence and blood, but now they have become a physical tonic that nourishes Chen Changsheng.
"Damn it!" Sakdo, who was suppressed in the Hall of Eternal Life at this moment, could not help but turn pale when he noticed this situation. He did not expect that the incarnation formed by his nine drops of blood would be destroyed like this.
"This person is truly terrifying!" Sakdo felt a deep sense of powerlessness in his heart.
At this moment, outside, the Seducer was killed, Sacdo was captured, and the men of the Seducer escaped, causing an uproar immediately.
"Humph, your leader Sakdo has become a prisoner of his subordinates. Do you still want to resist?"
Chen Changsheng freed his hand, holding the giant ax in his hand, looking coldly at the masters under Sacdo, and said word by word.
"Huh, why retreat? There are millions of soldiers behind us. We have no choice but to retreat. Let's fight him!" A big man snorted coldly. This big man was Deputy Commander Temuhan. His eyes were firm. "Even if you die in battle, you can't retreat!"
"Yes! Fight with him!"
"Fight! If it doesn't work, we will blow up the golden elixir and die together with this person!"
These people from the Fire Luo Kingdom were very bloody, with a desperate attitude. After saying that, Tiemuhan and the others looked at each other and at the same time shot the magic weapon at Chen Changsheng.
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
After Chen Changsheng finished speaking, his body disappeared in a flash, and then he appeared above Tie Muhan's head, and the giant ax in his hand struck hard at his head.
Tie Muhan's expression changed greatly, and he quickly raised his knife to resist. Who was Chen Changsheng's opponent? He was immediately split into two halves with the knife. The two halves of the body fell down, and his intestines flowed all over the floor.
With just one move, he was killed by Chen Changsheng. This Tiemuhan had the strength of more than 8,000 tigers. The gap between him and Chen Changsheng was so huge that he couldn't even catch a single move.
